schema.block_registration: parent checkpoint file SHA and logical frontier SHA, selected source split indices+nodes+queue counts
schema.certificates: one full 81-point margin certificate per tested source parent; passed false remains uncertified, never an H counterexample
schema.checkpoint: chained registration/certificates/retirement hashes; logical frontier hash and cumulative tested count
schema.final_state: all source fields preserved except passed/queue/splits; add task066/status066/fingerprint066/conversion066
schema.prefix_checkpoint: recoverable partial rows and cursor under frozen block registration
schema.retired: per-block removed source passed/queue/split indices, node and unique accepted ancestor

selection: only live untested source splits with a remaining queue descendant; (path depth,-initial queue descendant count,root index,path); exact candidate prefix registered before qualification
